value.text:
Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks.

- memos.memo.created → DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook (memo_service.go)
- memos.memo.updated → DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook (via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects)
- memos.memo.deleted → DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook (memo_service.go)
- memos.memo.comment.created → DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook (memo_service_comments.go)

All converge at `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` in `memo_service_webhooks.go`.

`webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` enqueues payloads to `asyncPostQueue`. Four background goroutines dequeue and call `webhook.Post(payload)` for actual HTTP delivery.

The three main lifecycle events route through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, while comment creation uses its own dispatcher. Both paths call `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, which delegates to `webhook.Post` for actual delivery.

q30.
memos.memo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memos.memo.comment.created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
internal/webhook/webhook.go: PostAsync → Post

These four events are defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Created, updated, and deleted share `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which sets the activity type and calls `webhook.PostAsync`; comment-created uses `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`, which also ends at `webhook.PostAsync`.

Call sites:
- **created** — `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
- **updated** — `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` (used from `UpdateMemo` and attachment/relation updates)
- **deleted** — `DeleteMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
- **comment.created** — `CreateMemoComment` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`

Delivery convergence is in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`: every dispatch enqueues via `PostAsync`, background workers drain `asyncPostQueue`, and actual HTTP delivery happens in `Post`.
